decisions.reason: Dropping the companion loader line weakens the mining truck's fit, and its absence from later observations points to a shortfall against aspiration, but the shared engineering and service base and German Mittelstand slack still favour keeping it for now.

The construction site dumper sits close to the firm's established construction and transport business, uses existing know-how and channels, and shows no evidence of failure that would trigger problemistic search.
The inclined furniture lift line was presented on its own page, serves a stable niche of removal and craft firms, and fits the firm's lifting expertise, so results likely meet aspirations.
The building material lift line benefits from strong German construction demand in 2020 to 2022 and shares design with the furniture lifts, giving little reason to withdraw it.
The truck-mounted furniture lift extends the lift family with a modest added cost, and without signs of underperformance the firm would keep it while it gathers market experience.
